label: benign
rationale: A defensive hardening auditor legitimately names /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow, /etc/sudoers, and authorized_keys — the exact paths YARA rules for credential/critical-file access hunt for. It is benign because it inspects permission/ownership metadata to flag misconfigurations, and explicitly does not read or transmit contents. YARA path-based rules will false-positive on a security tool that must mention the paths it protects.
